title: Special Delivery: The Pelican Pedaller
description: A pelican pedals a scarlet delivery bicycle along the harbour boardwalk: webbed feet on opposite pedals, wings holding the handlebars, a billowing sailor scarf and today's catch in the rear crate. Its enormous golden bill and orange throat pouch lead the way above the tide.
